dct_description_sm:
Polygon data representing the extent of the Highly Vulnerable Aquifers (HVAs) within the County of Essex as per the Clean Water Act.

Highly vulnerable aquifers are defined as subsurface, geologic formations that are sources of drinking water, which could relatively easily be impacted by the release of pollutants on the ground surface.

Contains data provided by the Essex Region Conservation Authority (ERCA) and the Lower Thames Conservation Authority (LTVCA) for the purpose of inclusion into the County of Essex Official Plan (2014). Please contact the Conservation Authority for the most up to date information.
